component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 10 ascending frame 174; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2026-06-26, sum of 8 consecutive pairs (2026-06-26_2026-07-08, 2026-07-08_2026-07-20, 2026-07-20_2026-08-13, 2026-08-13_2026-08-25, 2026-08-25_2026-09-06, 2026-09-06_2026-09-18, 2026-09-18_2026-09-30, 2026-09-30_2026-10-12). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at 106.8648E -6.1396N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane plus a linear elevation term (Copernicus DEM GLO-90) was removed from each pair (long-wavelength and elevation-correlated troposphere residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt).
